description: This file contains functions and variable definitions related to platform-specific upgrade procedures for embedded hardware, specifically tailored for a board identified as 'technexion,imx7d-pico-pi'. It handles enabling image metadata checks, checking if an image can be upgraded on the specific board, performing the upgrade, copying configuration, and pre-upgrade steps.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Enables image metadata verification if the board matches 'technexion,imx7d-pico-pi'.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the current image can be upgraded on the board; supports only 'technexion,imx7d-pico-pi'.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade procedure specific to the 'technexion,imx7d-pico-pi' board.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration for the upgrade process on the specific board.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Performs pre-upgrade steps for the specified board.
